name: Wedding Vows
source:
Wedding Vows is an anthology of 14 short snippets portraying the love story of Lawrence and Rebecca, two childhood sweethearts who grew up together and got married. It shows their evolving relationship from childhood until old age, and the special moments that bind them together. A tribute to marriage and idealised love with a vintage Americana feel.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5467]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
《Wedding Vows》由14段短篇組成，描繪青梅竹馬勞倫斯與蕾貝卡一同長大、相愛結婚的故事。從童年直至老年，作品展現兩人不斷變化的關係，以及把他們緊緊相連的特殊時刻。這是一曲獻給婚姻與理想化愛情的讚歌，帶有復古美國風情。

[譯自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=5467]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
